description: Utility service provider (BPDB) executes an unscheduled physical line disconnect or smart-meter lockout during off-peak hours due to localized grid instability. Reconnection requires physical utility inspection and regulatory clearances, breaching the 48-hour SLA and curtailing 100% of solar generation.
mitigant_efficacy: Step-in rights allow Netso to deploy regional technician with utility authorization, but bureaucratic delays typically extend lockout to 5-7 business days, exhausting ~3% of the BDT 578k escrow buffer per event.

description: Upon a payment default, the customer files a preemptive dispute in local court and obtains a temporary injunction/stay order on the BDT 578k escrow account and bank guarantee. This freezes Netso's access to the 6-month O&M and debt service coverage buffer during litigation.
mitigant_efficacy: Personal/corporate guarantees from directors remain enforceable, but legal execution in local courts typically requires 12-18 months, leading to technical default on IDCOL debt service.

description: A critical night electrical fault (e.g., inverter thermal runaway or breaker fire) triggers a automatic system shutdown at 3 AM. Host site security denies entry to Netso's emergency response team, citing nighttime security protocols and lack of corporate clearing, resulting in prolonged downtime and collateral plant damage.
mitigant_efficacy: PPA step-in rights are legally clear but operationally toothless during the critical first hours without pre-authorized physical site access passes for designated O&M staff.

description: Customer pays PPA invoice via mobile financial services (bKash/Nagad), but systemic transaction caps, tariff disputes, or gateway settlement lags delay the transfer of cash to the joint escrow account beyond the monthly bank deadline.
mitigant_efficacy: Triggers minor liquidity friction; escrow account holds 6 months of debt service, mitigating immediate default risk, but administrative overhead increases.

description: A midnight lightning strike or power surge destroys the on-site SCADA gateway and net-metering RTU (Remote Terminal Unit). In the absence of billing-grade generation telemetry, the customer refuses to pay estimated bills, delaying PPA cash collection by 45+ days.
mitigant_efficacy: Requires manual meter reading and manual verification, delaying billing cycle and stretching working capital requirements.

description: The local operating entity of the school/factory defaults on PPA payments while the parent guarantor undergoes corporate restructuring, transferring valuable assets to a new corporate shell, making personal and corporate guarantees virtually unrecoverable.
mitigant_efficacy: Allows Netso to exercise step-in rights to decommission and salvage the BDT 4.4M (80kW) solar asset, but asset liquidation and redeployment costs consume 40-50% of the recovered asset value.
